meta.title: Medusa Cloud — Accounting traceability for your business
meta.description: Medusa Cloud: multi-tenant accounting trust ledger for business units. Open source Core lives at medusa-ledger.

hero.title: Ledger (Blockchain) for accounting traceability for your business
hero.lead: Hosted multi-tenant product. The open source engine is Medusa Ledger Core.

what.title: The problem it solves
what.lead: This is not “having blockchain”. It answers with evidence:
what.q: Who generated which money, who received it, how much each participant was owed, and who can prove it?
what.c1_text: The ERP says what it recorded. Medusa says what actually happened: who generated it, who approved it, how it was split and reconciled.
what.c2_text: Each business unit has different partners: an isolated chain and its own Medusa hub — no mixed money across units.
what.c3_text: Your payment gateway collects. Medusa anchors the proof (hash + block). Odoo, SAP, BI and AI can consume that truth later.
what.c4_text: A traceability, reconciliation and governance layer: who generated which money, who received it, what each party was owed, and who can prove it — in real time.

flow.title: Accounting unit flow
flow.lead: User | customer → operator → your business unit → your tenant or ERP → payments, billing and distribution → regulatory entity.

mvp.title: MVP | demo
mvp.lead: Isolated chain per unit, anchored to real payments.
mvp.i3: Live hub: blocks, pending, seal, verify chain
mvp.i4: Medusa login + access from the unit dashboard

pitch.p1: Your company has a verifiable enterprise source of truth, independent from the ERP.
pitch.p2: Trust Ledger as a Service — Blockchain-as-a-Business-Ledger per business unit.
pitch.p3: The ERP stops being the origin of truth and becomes a consumer of truth.

model.title: Open Source Core + Medusa Cloud
model.c1_text: Odoo, SAP or your ERP keep running the business.
model.c2_text: Verifiable immutable evidence layer per unit.
model.c3_text: Consumes the chain to explain and audit.
model.c4_text: Reports on demonstrable facts, not just DB rows.
model.arch_text: Medusa Core (OSS) = ledger + API. Medusa Cloud = multi-tenant, white-label, payment anchors, hubs, SLA, ERP.
model.sponsors_text: Sponsors is not only donation: it’s an international discovery channel for Core. Cloud / Business / Enterprise remain the business.

erp.title: Natural evolution toward ERP
erp.lead: We don’t replace Odoo, SAP, or your ERP overnight — that’s impossible… We replace dependence on the ERP as the single source of truth.
erp.pain: We know the headache of DIAN electronic invoicing reports and public oversight and control entities. That’s why we built an accounting traceability ledger for ecosystems and businesses that need to monitor the trail of every transaction.
erp.restore_title: Medusa blockchain does not replace your ERP
erp.restore: It restores the ERP’s foundational nature and lifts the weight of accounting and fiscal responsibility off your database.
erp.g3_text: Business events → immutable ledger → ERP, AI and BI consume verifiable evidence.
erp.events_text: ORDER_CREATED, PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED, SERVICE_COMPLETED, COMMISSION_CALCULATED, SETTLEMENT_DONE, INVOICE_PAID… a fully reconstructable history.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Three steps for partners and operators of the unit.
how.step1_text: A payment, wallet top-up or unit credit creates the business fact.
how.step2_text: The tx enters pending, then seals into a block with previousHash and SHA-256.
how.step3_text: The hub shows the chain, filters by source and verifies integrity if a hash is tampered.

cta.title: Try Medusa on the Tuk Tuk demo unit
cta.text: Tuk Tuk is the demo business unit where the ledger already runs. Open the hub, verify the chain and watch accounting traceability live.

footer.blurb: Medusa Cloud — multi-tenant accounting traceability for business units. OSS Core at medusa-ledger.
